baselineDisplay.title: 不是百分百的小偷
baselineDisplay.text:
【故事复现】 不是百分百的小偷
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: How did Sam get his money back?
问题：萨姆的钱是怎么回来的？
• 词汇准备
• clear 无罪的，不亏心的
• conscience 良心，道德心
• wallet 钱包，钱夹
• savings 存款
• villager 村民
• per cent 百分之……
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
The whole village soon learnt that a large sum of money had been lost. Sam, the local butcher, had lost his wallet while taking his savings to the post office.
整个村子很快知道，有一大笔钱丢失了。当地的屠户萨姆在把存款送往邮局的途中把钱包丢了。
Sam was sure that the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers, but it was not returned to him.
萨姆确信钱包一定是被某个村民捡到了，可是却不见有人来送还给他。
Three months passed, and then one morning, Sam found his wallet outside his front door.
3 个月过去了，后来在一天早晨，萨姆在自己的大门外发现了他的钱包。
It had been wrapped up in newspaper and it contained half the money he had lost, together with a note which said: ‘A thief, yes, but only 50 per cent a thief!’
钱包是用报纸包着的，里面有他丢失的钱的一半，而且还附着一张纸条，上面写着:“一个小偷，是的，但只是一个 50%的小偷!”
Two months later, some more money was sent to Sam with another note: ‘Only 25 per cent a thief now!’
又过了两个月，又有一些钱送还给了萨姆，又附了一张纸条:“这回只是 25%的小偷了!”
In time, all Sam’s money was paid back in this way. The last note said: ‘I am 100 per cent honest now!’
很快，萨姆全部的钱都用同样的方式还了回来。最后的那张字条上写道: “我现在是一个 100%的老实人了!”
• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1 Where was the local butcher, Sam taking his savings? What did he lose?
2 Did Sam receive half his money three months later, or did he receive all his money? Did he receive a note or not?
3 What did the note say?
4 Did the thief include a note every time he sent Sam more money or not?
5 What did the last note say?
Answer: The local butcher, Sam, was taking his savings to the post office but he lost his wallet. Three months later, Sam not only received half his money but a note as well. The note said: 'A thief, yes, but only 50 per cent a thief!' The thief included a note every time he sent Sam more money. The last note said: 'I am 100 per cent honest now!'
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。
1 Someone _________.
(a) had stolen Sam's wallet
(b) had found Sam's wallet and kept it
(c) had lost Sam's wallet
(d) had taken the wallet from Sam's pock
2 The thief ________ in the end.
(a) kept Sam's money
(b) returned 50 per cent of the money
(c) returned 75 per cent of the money
(d) returned all the money
3 Sam was taking his savings to the post office _______ he lost his wallet.
(a) when
(b) while
(c) as
(d) just as
4 He was taking his savings to the post office. He keeps his savings ______ the post office.
(a) to
(b) in
(c) on
(d) into
5 The wallet was found ______ one of the villagers.
(a) from
(b) by
(c) out of
(d) of
6 ______ had it been wrapped up in? A newspaper.
(a) Where
(b) Who
(c) How
(d) What
7 Some more money was sent to Sam. Sam ______ some more money.
(a) sent
(b) has sent
(c) was sent
(d) had sent
8 We usually keep _______ in a wallet.
(a) coins
(b) notes
(c) cheques
(d) photographs
9 The thief had _______ the wallet in newspaper.
(a) wound
(b) rolled
(c) wrapped
(d) bound
10 How much did it contain? How much _______?
(a) did it consist
(b) was there in it
(c) did it include
(d) had it
11 Sam read the thief's note. In this sentence, 'note' means _______.
(a) money
(b) a coin
(c) a cheque
(d) message
12 _______ all Sam's money was returned.
(a) At times
(b) After a time
(c) With the times
(d) A long time
Key: 1 b 2 d 3 a 4 b 5 b 6 d 7 c 8 b 9 c 10 b 11 d 12 b
第三十五单元【语法点拨】 虚拟语气在名词性从句中的用法(上)
除了动词 wish 和某些句型外,虚拟语气在名词性从句——主语从句、宾语从句、表语从句和同位语从句的表现形式是一样的，动词原形或“should+动词原形”。在美国英语中，一般只用动词原形。
• 虚拟语气在主语从句中的应用
在某些表示命令、要求、决定、建议、安排、主张以及“重要性、紧迫性”等的主语从句中,谓语动词要用虚拟语气。谓语动词用 should+动词原形或动词原形。在美国英语中,通常省略 should, 用动词原形。这类主语从句的构成形式为:It is/was+形容词/现在分词/过去分词/名词+that。
▪ 在含有形容词或其相应的名词的主语从句中,注意掌握如下形容词:
necessary, imperative(必要的,势在必行的), important, essential(必要的), vital(至关重要的), advisable(可取的;明智的), better, best, compulsory(强制的;强迫的), appropriate(适当的), crucial(极重要的), fitting(适当的), obligatory(义不容辞的;必须的), preferable(更可取的), urgent(紧迫的; 非常重要的), instant(紧急的), proper(适当的)等。
• It is essential that the application form (should) be sent back before the deadline.
申请表必须在截止期前送回。
• It is vital that enough money be collected to fund the project.
重要的是募集足够的钱,为这个项目提供资金。
▪ It is/was+过去分词+that····，重点应掌握这些动词:
advise(建议; 劝告), arrange(安排), ask, command(命令), decide, demand(要求), desire(期望,希望), move(提议,动议) ，order, prefer, propose(建议), recommend(推荐,建议), request(请求,要求), require(要求), resolve(决定,决议), suggest, urge(催促;力劝), vote(投票;表决)等。
• It is advised that you should not eat the fish coming from the lake.
建议你不要吃那种来自这个湖的鱼。
• It is arranged that you should enter for this competition.
已经安排你报名参加这次竞赛。
• It has been decided that the meeting be postponed till next Saturday
已经决定，会议延期到下星期六举行。
• It is proposed that the meeting be called off. 有人建议取消这次会议。
▪ 在 it is a pity/shame that, it is natural/odd/strange/incredible/amazing/ridiculous/从句中,表示惊讶、怀疑时,从句中的谓语动词用 “should+动词原形”或“should + have+过去分词”, should 含有“竟然”之意。
• It is strange that he should do that. 真奇怪，他竟然那样做。
• It is odd that she should have failed to see her own shortcomings.
真奇怪，她竟然没有看出自己的缺点。
• It is a great pity that he should be so arrogant.
真遗憾，他竟会这样自高自大。
▶ 虚拟语气在宾语从句中的应用
表示“坚持、命令、建议、要求”等意思的宾语从句要用虚拟语气。这类动词一般可归纳为“一个坚持(insist)、两个命令(order，command)、三个建议(advise, suggest propose)，四个要求(demand, require, request, ask)”。这类虚拟语气由“should+动词原形”构成,其中的 should 在美国英语中通常省略。
▪ 含 insist 有(坚持)的宾语从句
• He insisted that we (should) take the doctor’s advice.
他坚持我们要遵照医嘱。
• Rose insisted that he be present at the conference.
罗斯坚持要他出席会议。
注: insist 表示“坚持要”“一定要”，从句多指尚未实现的想法，谓语通常用虚拟语气；如果表示“坚持说”“坚持认为”, 从句所指的多为已经发生的事或已存在的状态，谓语用陈述语气。
I insisted that he (should) go. 我坚持要他去。
I insisted that he was wrong. 我坚持认为他错了。
He insisted that I should read his letter. 他坚持要我看他的信。
He insisted that I had read his letter. 他坚持说我看过他的信。
▪ 含 order, command(命令)的宾语从句
• He commanded that we(should) attack at once. 他命令我们立即发起进攻。
• The pirate chief commanded that the hostages be shot on the spot.
海盗头子命令将人质就地枪决。
▪ 含 advise, suggest, propose, recommend(建议)的宾语从句
• The doctor advised that he should not smoke. 医生建议他不要抽烟。
• They recommend that this tax be done away with. 他们建议废除这种税。
• The committee proposed that Mr. Smith be elected.
该委员会建议推选史密斯先生。
• He suggested that we should leave early. 他建议我们早点动身。
注:与动词 insist 相似,动词 suggest 后接宾语从句时,除可用虚拟语气外,也可用陈述语气。两者的区别是：若谓语动词所表示的情况尚未成为事实，则用虚拟语气，此时 suggest 通常译为“建议”;若谓语动词所表示的情况为既成事实，则要用陈述语气，此时的 suggest 通常译为“表明”“暗示”“认为”
She suggested that we(should) leave early. 她建议我们早点动身。
比较: Her expression suggested that she was angry. 她的表情表明了她生气了。
▪ 含有 ask, demand, require, request(要求)的宾语从句
• I asked that he (should) leave right away. 我要求他马上走开。
• The students demand that the library be open every day.
学生要求图书馆每天开放。
• Current regulations require that students go to the primary and junior middle schools nearest to their homes.
现行规定要求中小学生就近入学。
▪ 含有 move, vote(提议、投票)的宾语从句
• I move that we accept the proposal. 我提议通过这项提案。
• Congress has voted that the present law be maintained.
国会已表决保留当前这条法律。
• I vote that we all go home. 我建议我们都回家。(vote 口语中作“建议”解)
▪ 含有 urge, arrange, direct(敦促、安排、指示)的宾语从句
• We urge that you make this settlement without delay.
我们迫切要求您能速予结清这部分账。
• He arranged that I should go abroad for inspection next month.
他安排我下月去国外考察。
• The general directed that the prisoners be set free.
将军指示释放那些俘虏。
▪ 含有 desire, intend(希望、打算)的宾语从句
• He desires that these letters be burnt after his death.
他希望在他死后把这些信件烧毁。
• We intend that it be done today. 我们打算今天做完这事。

display.title: 不是百分百的小偷
display.text:
【故事复现】 不是百分百的小偷
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: How did Sam get his money back?
问题：萨姆的钱是怎么回来的？
• 词汇准备
• clear 无罪的，不亏心的
• conscience 良心，道德心
• wallet 钱包，钱夹
• savings 存款
• villager 村民
• per cent 百分之……
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
The whole village soon learnt that a large sum of money had been lost. Sam, the local butcher, had lost his wallet while taking his savings to the post office.
整个村子很快知道，有一大笔钱丢失了。当地的屠户萨姆在把存款送往邮局的途中把钱包丢了。
Sam was sure that the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers, but it was not returned to him.
萨姆确信钱包一定是被某个村民捡到了，可是却不见有人来送还给他。
Three months passed, and then one morning, Sam found his wallet outside his front door.
3 个月过去了，后来在一天早晨，萨姆在自己的大门外发现了他的钱包。
It had been wrapped up in newspaper and it contained half the money he had lost, together with a note which said: ‘A thief, yes, but only 50 per cent a thief!’
钱包是用报纸包着的，里面有他丢失的钱的一半，而且还附着一张纸条，上面写着:“一个小偷，是的，但只是一个 50%的小偷!”
Two months later, some more money was sent to Sam with another note: ‘Only 25 per cent a thief now!’
又过了两个月，又有一些钱送还给了萨姆，又附了一张纸条:“这回只是 25%的小偷了!”
In time, all Sam’s money was paid back in this way. The last note said: ‘I am 100 per cent honest now!’
最终，萨姆全部的钱都用同样的方式还了回来。最后的那张字条上写道: “我现在是一个 100%的老实人了!”
• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1 Where was the local butcher, Sam, taking his savings? What did he lose?
2 Did Sam receive half his money three months later, or did he receive all his money? Did he receive a note or not?
3 What did the note say?
4 Did the thief include a note every time he sent Sam more money or not?
5 What did the last note say?
Answer: The local butcher, Sam, was taking his savings to the post office but he lost his wallet. Three months later, Sam not only received half his money but a note as well. The note said: 'A thief, yes, but only 50 per cent a thief!' The thief included a note every time he sent Sam more money. The last note said: 'I am 100 per cent honest now!'
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。
1 Someone _________.
(a) had stolen Sam's wallet
(b) had found Sam's wallet and kept it
(c) had lost Sam's wallet
(d) had taken the wallet from Sam's pocket
2 The thief ________ in the end.
(a) kept Sam's money
(b) returned 50 per cent of the money
(c) returned 75 per cent of the money
(d) returned all the money
3 Sam was taking his savings to the post office _______ he lost his wallet.
(a) when
(b) during
(c) since then
(d) meanwhile
4 He was taking his savings to the post office. He keeps his savings ______ the post office.
(a) to
(b) in
(c) on
(d) into
5 The wallet was found ______ one of the villagers.
(a) from
(b) by
(c) out of
(d) of
6 ______ had it been wrapped up in? A newspaper.
(a) Where
(b) Who
(c) How
(d) What
7 Some more money was sent to Sam. Sam ______ some more money.
(a) sent
(b) has sent
(c) was sent
(d) had sent
8 Paper money kept in a wallet is called _______.
(a) coins
(b) notes
(c) cheques
(d) photographs
9 The thief had _______ the wallet in newspaper.
(a) wound
(b) rolled
(c) wrapped
(d) bound
10 How much did it contain? How much _______?
(a) did it consist
(b) was there in it
(c) did it include
(d) had it
11 Sam read the thief's note. In this sentence, 'note' means _______.
(a) money
(b) a coin
(c) a cheque
(d) a message
12 _______ all Sam's money was returned.
(a) At times
(b) After a time
(c) With the times
(d) A long time

第三十五单元【语法点拨】 虚拟语气在名词性从句中的用法(上)
名词性从句中表达要求、建议、必要性等时，常用动词原形（mandative subjunctive），也可用 should + 动词原形。不同意义、语体和英语变体的选择有所不同，不能推广为所有名词性从句的统一规则。
• 虚拟语气在主语从句中的应用
表达要求、建议、必要性等的 It is/was ... that ... 结构，常用动词原形或 should + 动词原形。美式英语较常用原形；这是一种使用倾向，不是英美英语之间的绝对限制。
▪ 在含有形容词或其相应的名词的主语从句中,注意掌握如下形容词:
necessary, imperative(必要的,势在必行的), important, essential(必要的), vital(至关重要的), advisable(可取的;明智的), better, best, compulsory(强制的;强迫的), appropriate(适当的), crucial(极重要的), fitting(适当的), obligatory(义不容辞的;必须的), preferable(更可取的), urgent(紧迫的; 非常重要的), proper(适当的)等。
• It is essential that the application form (should) be sent back before the deadline.
申请表必须在截止期前送回。
• It is vital that enough money be collected to fund the project.
重要的是募集足够的钱,为这个项目提供资金。
▪ It is/was+过去分词+that····，重点应掌握这些动词:
advise(建议; 劝告), arrange(安排), ask, command(命令), decide, demand(要求), desire(期望,希望), move(提议,动议) ，order, prefer, propose(建议), recommend(推荐,建议), request(请求,要求), require(要求), resolve(决定,决议), suggest, urge(催促;力劝), vote(投票;表决)等。
• It is advised that you should not eat the fish coming from the lake.
建议你不要吃那种来自这个湖的鱼。
• It is arranged that you should enter for this competition.
已经安排你报名参加这次竞赛。
• It has been decided that the meeting be postponed till next Saturday.
已经决定，会议延期到下星期六举行。
• It is proposed that the meeting be called off. 有人建议取消这次会议。
▪ 在 It is/was a pity/shame that ... 或 It is/was natural/odd/strange/incredible/amazing/ridiculous that ... 等结构中，可用 should + 动词原形或 should have + 过去分词表示惊讶、遗憾等情绪。这类 should 常见于英式英语，并非必须；也可用陈述形式。
• It is strange that he should do that. 真奇怪，他竟然那样做。
• It is odd that she should have failed to see her own shortcomings.
真奇怪，她竟然没有看出自己的缺点。
• It is a great pity that he should be so arrogant.
真遗憾，他竟会这样自高自大。
▶ 虚拟语气在宾语从句中的应用
表示要求、命令或建议时，insist、order、command、advise、suggest、propose、demand、require、request、ask 等动词后的 that 从句常用动词原形或 should + 动词原形。须按动词的具体意义判断，不能只见到这个词就套用。
▪ 含有 insist（坚持要求）的宾语从句
• He insisted that we (should) take the doctor’s advice.
他坚持我们要遵照医嘱。
• Rose insisted that he be present at the conference.
罗斯坚持要他出席会议。
注：insist 表示坚持要求时，可用动词原形或 should + 动词原形；表示坚持声称某事时，按所声称内容使用相应时态。区别在于词义与功能，并非单看事情是否已经发生。
I insisted that he (should) go. 我坚持要他去。
I insisted that he was wrong. 我坚持认为他错了。
He insisted that I should read his letter. 他坚持要我看他的信。
He insisted that I had read his letter. 他坚持说我看过他的信。
▪ 含 order, command(命令)的宾语从句
• He commanded that we(should) attack at once. 他命令我们立即发起进攻。
• The pirate chief commanded that the hostages be shot on the spot.
海盗头子命令将人质就地枪决。
▪ 含 advise, suggest, propose, recommend(建议)的宾语从句
• The doctor advised that he should not smoke. 医生建议他不要抽烟。
• They recommend that this tax be done away with. 他们建议废除这种税。
• The committee proposed that Mr. Smith be elected.
该委员会建议推选史密斯先生。
• He suggested that we should leave early. 他建议我们早点动身。
注：suggest 表示建议采取行动时，可用动词原形或 should + 动词原形；表示表明、暗示或提出某种判断时，从句按所谈内容选时态和情态形式，所指可以是过去、现在或未来，不一定是已经证实的事实。
She suggested that we(should) leave early. 她建议我们早点动身。
比较: Her expression suggested that she was angry. 她的表情表明了她生气了。
▪ 含有 ask, demand, require, request(要求)的宾语从句
• I asked that he (should) leave right away. 我要求他马上走开。
• The students demand that the library be open every day.
学生要求图书馆每天开放。
• The rules of this game require that each player take one card.
这个游戏的规则要求每位玩家拿一张牌。（自拟语法例句。）
▪ 含有 move, vote(提议、投票)的宾语从句
• I move that we accept the proposal. 我提议通过这项提案。
• Congress has voted that the present law be maintained.
国会已表决保留当前这条法律。
• I vote that we all go home. 我建议我们都回家。(vote 口语中作“建议”解)
▪ 含有 urge, arrange, direct(敦促、安排、指示)的宾语从句
• We urge that you make this settlement without delay.
我们迫切要求您能速予结清这部分账。
• He arranged that I should go abroad for inspection next month.
他安排我下月去国外考察。
• The general directed that the prisoners be set free.
将军指示释放那些俘虏。
▪ 含有 desire, intend(希望、打算)的宾语从句
• He desires that these letters be burnt after his death.
他希望在他死后把这些信件烧毁。
• We intend that it be done today. 我们打算今天做完这事。

corrections.before: 表示“坚持、命令、建议、要求”等意思的宾语从句要用虚拟语气。这类动词一般可归纳为“一个坚持(insist)、两个命令(order，command)、三个建议(advise, suggest propose)，四个要求(demand, require, request, ask)”。这类虚拟语气由“should+动词原形”构成,其中的 should 在美国英语中通常省略。

corrections.after: 注：insist 表示坚持要求时，可用动词原形或 should + 动词原形；表示坚持声称某事时，按所声称内容使用相应时态。区别在于词义与功能，并非单看事情是否已经发生。

corrections.before: 注:与动词 insist 相似,动词 suggest 后接宾语从句时,除可用虚拟语气外,也可用陈述语气。两者的区别是：若谓语动词所表示的情况尚未成为事实，则用虚拟语气，此时 suggest 通常译为“建议”;若谓语动词所表示的情况为既成事实，则要用陈述语气，此时的 suggest 通常译为“表明”“暗示”“认为”
corrections.after: 注：suggest 表示建议采取行动时，可用动词原形或 should + 动词原形；表示表明、暗示或提出某种判断时，从句按所谈内容选时态和情态形式，所指可以是过去、现在或未来，不一定是已经证实的事实。
